coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: MB4E
record.summary: A 398-unit, two-phase affordable housing development at 1290 3rd St on Mission Bay South Block 4-East, bounded by Mission Rock, Third and China Basin Streets, being developed by Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services (as Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.) with OCII under an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement. Phase I (165 units, ~160 ft) is on the southern half of the block, facing China Basin St; Phase II (233 units, ~225 ft) is on the northern half, facing Mission Rock St.

facts.value: Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services, as Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.
398 total: Phase I 165 units (163 affordable + 2 manager units, ~160 ft, China Basin St frontage); Phase II 233 units (231 affordable + 2 manager units, ~225 ft, Mission Rock St frontage)

All residential units (394 of 398, excluding 4 manager units) restricted to 70% AMI or below per the April 2026 CEQA Notice of Exemption -- this is the legally operative restriction. Earlier and secondary sources give different ranges (30-80% AMI per the 2024 ENA staff memo; ~35-95% AMI per the developer's own project site) -- see open_questions.
Approximately 1,253 sq ft ground-floor retail, Phase I
8711029B (1290 3rd St), confirmed via DataSF's Parcels - Active and Retired dataset; subdivided by Tentative Parcel Map No. 12743 (2026-03-31) into separate Phase I and Phase II lots

open_questions: Affordability figures differ across sources: the April 2026 CEQA Notice of Exemption (the most recent, legally binding source) restricts all 394 residential units to 70% AMI or below; the 2024 ENA staff memo cited 30-80% AMI; the developer's own project site (mb4e.com) still advertises 35% to ~95% AMI. The NOE is treated as authoritative here.

Construction start dates (Phase I early 2027, Phase II 2028) and completion targets (Phase I leasing 2029, Phase II completion ~2030) are sourced only to the developer's own project site, not yet confirmed by an OCII resolution or staff report -- flagged as expected/approximate.
OCII Resolution No. 04-2026 (Phase II predevelopment loan) is referenced in the Feb 2026 resolutions' recitals but was not independently read; its terms are not detailed here.
No public official's or community group's stated position on this project has been found and sourced.

Whether the site is currently a surface parking lot, and whether the project is administratively separate from the Giants/Tishman Speyer Mission Rock masterplan, are not stated in any cited document: the parking lot rests on Pier & Point's own on-site observation (2026-09-13), and the record no longer asserts either in its summary.

The Spring 2026 SF development forecast (media.api.sf.gov/documents/Spring_2026_DEV_Forecast.pdf) could not be read on 2026-09-29; the construction start dates rest on the developer's own site (mb4e.com: Phase I Q1 2027, Phase II Q1 2028, pending financing).

record.notes: MB4E -- 398-unit, 100% affordable (30-95% AMI per SF YIMBY, 2025) two-phase development (Phase I: 165 units/16 stories on the southern half of the block, facing China Basin and Third Streets; Phase II: 233 units/23 stories on the northern half, facing Mission Rock and Third Streets, per the 2026 OCII Notice of Exemption), plus an approximately 1,253 sq ft ground-floor retail space (same Notice of Exemption; SF YIMBY's 2025 article gave 1,280 sq ft), at 1290 3rd St (DataSF Parcels) on the block bounded by Mission Rock, Third and China Basin Streets. Developed by Curtis Development + Bayview Senior Services under SF's Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII) in the Mission Bay South Redevelopment Project Area. No cited source describes it as part of, or administratively separate from, the Giants/Tishman Speyer Mission Rock masterplan (the Verde/Canyon rows above), though it sits next to that area and faces a street named Mission Rock St. Site use: Pier & Point observed a surface parking lot here on the ground (2026-09-13); no cited document states this. Construction: the developer's project site (mb4e.com) lists Phase I construction start Q1 2027 and Phase II Q1 2028, pending financing, with bid packages through Q3 2026; SF's Spring 2026 development forecast (media.api.sf.gov/documents/Spring_2026_DEV_Forecast.pdf) was cited for the same schedule but could not be read on 2026-09-29. Not under vertical construction as of 2026-09-13 (Pier & Point's own observation), despite likely visible fencing/site-prep activity. NOTE: added after Pier & Point's own on-the-ground observation of this lot; the other facts were checked against OCII commission exhibits, the Notice of Exemption and DataSF parcel records. (mb4e.com; sfyimby.com/2025/06/renderings-revealed-for-23-story-affordable-housing-in-mission-bay-san-francisco.html; media.api.sf.gov/documents/Spring_2026_DEV_Forecast.pdf)
